notes.title: Updated Demo v0.6 !
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/0b920c3216981f7837572c896f45af25788e3d7f.png"][/img][/p][p]
Hello!
At last, we were able to update many of the things 
that had been pointed out in your feedback :)

When we first released the demo, our mindset was simply, 
[i]“As long as it runs, it’s OK.”[/i]
We focused on just getting something out, even if it felt lacking.

But now, we’ve reached the stage 
where we can—and must—aim for true [i]“release and completion.”[/i]
That’s why we’ve decided it’s time to properly upgrade the game.

There are tough times in making this game, 
but we’re grateful that we’ve been able to keep pushing forward. 
And it’s all thanks to you.

We’ll do our best to finish it to the end!
Thank you, always.[/p][hr][/hr][list][*][p][b]Stage[/b]
- Adjusted the difficulty of certain stages on Easy
[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Boss Battles[/b] 
- Reduced boss HP on Easy 
- Added a new defeat cutscene for Stage 1 boss [i]Yozoh[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Misc[/b]
- Sound effects now stop immediately when a new one plays (prevents excessive volume buildup)
- Jump height is now consistent regardless of frame rate[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Display Options[/b]
- Improved the 'Resolution' setting for clarity
- Added 'Screen Mode' options (Fullscreen, Borderless Fullscreen, Windowed)
- Added 'Frame Rate' option[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Key Mapping Options[/b]
- Keyboard UI navigation, confirm, cancel, and options can now be remapped
- Controller key mapping is now supported[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b]
- Fixed an issue where player animations sometimes displayed incorrectly after game over
- Fixed an issue where the player could shift away from the camera center after game over
- Fixed the spawn position of the 'Bomb Bug' bomb so it aligns correctly with the sprite
- Various minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][i]*If the update has been applied correctly, "v0.6" will appear at the bottom right of the main menu.
If it does not appear, please delete and reinstall the game.
[/i][/p][p]Feedback and bug reports are always welcome!
Thank you, as always :)[/p]

notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/80034ba5c3ea4390e0508a2fee4f8760fb995c3a.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello!!
[/p][p]August is already over, and summer is nearly gone.
I’m here to share the August development log![/p][hr][/hr][p]Feel free to leave any questions at any time! [/p][p]
*This update includes details about Stage 2, currently in development.

 **I’ve tried to avoid spoilers as much as possible, 
but if you’d like to preserve the full experience, please refrain from reading further.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]\[Witch’s Objet -Nana’s Case-][/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/54d542e844bc274b5999f566e21aa7f27e19a809.png"][/img]This is shaping up to be the most harrowing part of the game.
We’re working on “The Witch’s Objet.”[/p][p]
I’ve written and erased these words countless times—
and even now, I’m still agonizing over how to finalize its content and direction.[/p][p]
It’s a part that wears down not only the creator,
but also the players—
and even the characters within the game itself.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/835206c98fa2945367913ed918d5f2f742b72604.png"][/img]But it is precisely this part—
utterly broken and grotesquely twisted—
that stands as the very reason I’m making this game,[/p][p]
and the reason KILL THE WITCH might carve itself a little deeper into your memory.
Above all, it’s what makes Yonah’s swing of her baseball bat truly justified.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]\[Video][/b][/p][p]We’ve been paying special attention to the sound and direction in this part.
[/p][previewyoutube="Sy7j0ZJgf2g;full"][/previewyoutube][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/Sy7j0ZJgf2g"][/dynamiclink][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]\[Demo 0.6 Update in Preparation][/b][/p][list][*][p]Made Easy mode easier[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various bugs and logic errors[/p][/*][*][p]Improved key-mapping features[/p][/*][/list][p]Currently in preparation!
The update is planned for September.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]<In Closing>[/b] [/p][p]Summer is already beginning to fade away.
Wishing you good health as always, and I’ll see you again with the September dev log.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you, as always :3[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/bd74b49d81859111cd21715044498ea65c6aa0a8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 2025.06 DevLog
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/0d5efd7a37f38c95f03d3dffed372c731e96644d.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone!
[/p][p]It’s already July... I can’t believe June has come and gone.
Lately, I find myself wondering, “Has time ever flown by this quickly before?”—that’s how each day feels.[/p][p]
How was your June?[/p][p]
Today, I’d like to share our June Development Log, 
along with a brief notice about delays in the development schedule.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]June Development Log[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We made progress on background images, 
added new regular enemies, and worked on parts of the boss's first phase.[/p][p]
Here are some screenshots and clips of our work in progress![/p][p]
[b]*Thank you for your understanding that everything is still under development.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/e76816db90cc5cfa4c451dd49deaa5620c519752.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/ea8373d07246bc99d66afa57dd7ecdb3f6d410fa.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/651d3f8332d1670ea8ca8408662a0f0094142a6f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/69d36fedd7cbef5341a4798ca26d634666730f6b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/1c0688770d3acd712064195e42fd017e1de8a6fe.png"][/img][/p][p]One of the most common pieces of feedback we received 
about Stage 1 was that the stage sections felt a bit monotonous.[/p][p]
That’s understandable—Stage 1 serves as both a tutorial and an introduction to the world, and since the boss character Yozoh isn’t someone who really cares about aesthetics or appearances, there weren’t many areas (outside the underground section) that had a strong sense of personality or character.[/p][p]
With Stage 2, we’re trying something different.[/p][p]
This time, we’re focusing on making the stage feel distinctly like the domain of the boss character—a space that reflects their personality and presence much more strongly.[/p][p][/p][p][b]KILL THE WITCH - 202506 DevLog [/b][/p][previewyoutube="AS7QHqcdgBE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/AS7QHqcdgBE"][/dynamiclink][b]*You can find more details in the video above.[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Notice: Development Schedule Delay[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]After carefully reviewing our current progress, we’ve come to the conclusion that we won’t be able to deliver the game at a satisfying level of quality within July as originally planned.[/p][p]It’s with a heavy heart that we announce the following delays in our development schedule.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/b245ced40ef50aed784716a3716be30699054f57.png"][/img]We sincerely apologize for the change from the schedule we originally promised.[/p][p]
That said, please rest assured—this is not due to any setbacks in development!
In fact, as we’ve continued working, we’ve become more deeply immersed in the project’s themes and started aiming even higher.[/p][p]As a result, the scope has expanded significantly beyond our initial plans.[/p][p]
This includes:
A greater variety of regular enemies
More detailed backgrounds featuring character illustrations
Enhanced cutscenes, effects, and sound work[/p][p]
Of course, no matter the reason, we acknowledge that we've broken a promise—
and for that, we are truly sorry.[/p][p]
This delay is entirely in the interest of delivering a better, more complete version of KILL THE WITCH,
and we’d be incredibly grateful for your understanding and patience.

As someone who wants this game to exist in its best possible form—not just as a developer, but as one of its most eager believers—[/p][p]
I promise to keep pouring everything I have into this project until the very end.[/p][p]Thank you always for your support.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/958f41081526dbbfd45a10578e1da5889e8003f2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 2025.05 DevLog
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/8d1e2b76a1a11e1e180d76f9b14a0c09a1263da3.png[/img]

Hello there!
As watermelons start to taste sweeter and mosquitoes begin to show up,
the end of May brings both humid warmth and the occasional refreshing chill.
(At least here in Korea, where I live.)

I recently took out my fan and wiped off the dust.
How are your preparations for summer coming along?

-----

[b]*This post includes information about Stage 2, which is currently in development.
**While I’ve done my best to avoid spoilers, please refrain from reading further if you wish to experience it all firsthand.[/b]

-----

[b]<Reflections on Eroticism and Pornography>[/b]

“Is it eroticism or is it pornography?”
“Is it art or is it obscenity?”
These are long-standing, perhaps now overused, debates.

And yet, they are far from concluded.
They remain unresolved questions—questions that will likely never disappear.

Should sexually explicit material be unconditionally condemned?
Sexuality is a natural, inescapable part of human nature.
It is intimately tied to life and to vitality.
So no, not necessarily.

Then should sexual content be unconditionally affirmed?
That too demands caution.
There undeniably exist works of expression that amount to nothing more
than the discharge of distorted desires—
creations steeped in hatred, or driven by vengeance.

The ethical boundaries of expression are not fixed truths,
but shifting lines drawn and redrawn by the context of the times.
Even so-called “extreme expressions” may, in the hands of intent and awareness,
transform into genuine works of art.

To one person, even the most vulgar piece may serve
as fertile ground for a new and intriguing creative endeavor.
But if there were no such thing as taboo in our society at all,
then paradoxically, every attempt to challenge or transgress a boundary
would lose its very reason for being.

Perhaps this is the tragedy—and the beauty—
of a world where black and white can never be cleanly separated.

As someone who creates games centered around “bishoujo” and “bishounen” characters,
these are questions I occasionally contemplate in solitude.

After all, isn’t the act of calling someone “pretty” or “handsome”
already entangled—however subtly—with a judgment of sexual attractiveness?

-----

[b]<Nana and Stage 2>[/b]

I’ve gone on for quite a while, haven’t I?
All of this was, in the end, a long-winded excuse for why I wanted to include something “sexual” in Stage 2.

Of course, that doesn’t mean KILL THE WITCH is turning into an adults-only game.
Nor is “sensual expression” the central theme of Stage 2.

Still, I wanted to walk that dangerous tightrope—
to balance on the edge of a subject often seen as taboo.

Because, simply put, that’s what makes it more fun!

And from that impulse, the concept of Stage 2’s boss character,
Miss Nana, was born—
a character who hones what she’s been given,
and wields it with fierce intention.

-----

*Please note that all images and footage below are from a work still in development.

[b]<About Nana>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/232ea0f10b11c8d4a6cb6b47273f0b4c96a94bc3.png[/img]

Just as the boss of Stage 1, “Yozoh,” takes his name from the protagonist of Osamu Dazai’s novel No Longer Human—
the boss of Stage 2, “Nana,” also borrows her name from literature:
Émile Zola’s Nana.

In KILL THE WITCH, Nana is a terrifying witch who will stop at nothing to achieve her goals.
She has resolved to make use of whatever power she possesses,
and so she wields her greatest “weapon” without hesitation.

Whether it's right or wrong? That’s of no concern to her whatsoever.

Even if bugs fall helplessly in love with her,
even if they flail and squander everything they have—
that’s not her problem.

It’s not like she ever forced them to, is it?

-----

[b]<Stage 2>[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/f03f1be73f7c66b109d35461be7febd8af90945f.png[/img]

After her battle with “Yozoh,” Yonah continues pushing forward—
until she enters an industrial zone filled with clanking, mechanical noise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/7b1d874b8dfabf34f8ce9262dec15dfccc177170.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/ff0694695aec005db9c0b985258ad0efe33b427e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/0c76cc2fab5c3ff1986601c8722df455dfd1cb11.png[/img]

This “creepily adorable” love factory is the setting for Stage 2.
You’ll find digital billboards featuring Nana scattered throughout the plant,
and the stage is being built with various symbols and parodies in mind!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/9c3978718a1e0563617ed8b908b58323a29e0fb7.png[/img]

Of course, even if you don’t catch every symbol or reference,
the context will still be clear enough to enjoy without confusion.

Video Link
KILL THE WITCH - Stage 2 First Look (Work in Progress)
[previewyoutube=vHYHkOAkKYQ;full]https://youtu.be/vHYHkOAkKYQ?si=W_5U5UVLyAyUdGsG[/previewyoutube]

-----

[b]<Closing Words>[/b]

Today’s update focused mainly on the stage itself.
In June, I’ll be sharing a glimpse of the boss battle!

As always, thank you so much :)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/7b4c945cacb803b88c4171af21b29f6ff84b9b7b.png[/img]

notes.title: Crowdfunding for KILL THE WITCH will begin
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/6cad739830b72e75c42bae854b76d49eca355c91.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=T1IguIrPYcI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]About Tumblbug Funding[/h2]
KILL THE WITCH's Tumblbug funding will begin on 2025-03-21 9:00(KST)!
Please check out the Tumblbug link below for more information.
[url=https://tumblbug.com/killthewitch]https://tumblbug.com/killthewitch[/url]

We realize that participating in the funding and accessing information outside of Korea can be difficult.
That's why we've summarized the information on this page.

[b]*Even if the funding is completely unsuccessful, the game will still be developed to the end![/b]

[h3]Development Schedule[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/b9c4bb07eaa902dccfb067e35de55343b020135d.png[/img]
[b]March 21st (KST):[/b] Funding Start Date
[b]April 21 (KST):[/b] Funding End Date
[b]May 10:[/b] Private Discord goes live
[b]In July:[/b] Beta testing via private discord
[b]In September:[/b] Early access to Stage 2
[b]Q1/2026 - Q2/2026:[/b] Full Release up to Stage 6

Our current anticipated development timeline is as shown above.
For Discord, we plan to open it privately to “Digital Deluxe” and higher backers in our funding, 
and then open it to the public at the start of Early Access in September.

[h3]Rewards at a Glance[/h3]
Below are some photos of the rewards we have in store for this round of funding.
You'll see some new illustrations and a sneak peek at what Stage 2 will look like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/9181b700450e52fa5623ad7c1da986ee02929cac.jpg[/img]

[h3]Multiple images[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/8e2298a839947a31e40f0d7919005cf4e9798220.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/e1b6f48782381cddd7b3bd35787a31f9e2ef7245.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/eb758c4f03cb862a84bfefe71d9300c838f58269.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/2f8d0796cfc8a2d7e861cc7c8ef36ae1130269fb.png[/img]
*This image is currently under development.

[h3]SnakeEagle?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/e024158c7cb521baca6120a38778b237cb028a81.png[/img]
I'm a big fan of Nietzsche's “Thus Spake Zarathustra”.
It's a fascinating book that I can't stop reading even though I'm not sure what it means.

In the book, the 'snake' and 'eagle' are Zarathustra's animals 
and are metaphors for 'wisdom' and 'pride' respectively.

So [ SnakeEagle ] means 'wisdom with pride'.
It also stands for the eternal return: “Live your life so that it's something you'd want to repeat forever."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/0aa0b2f0dd5267b34fb661b69da7d193eee98647.png[/img]
What's with the crying bug in the middle of the logo?
That's me, you, and our decadent selves just shaking like, “What is that, I'm scared."

Well, who cares about game company logos and philosophies.
As long as the game is fun, anything goes.

[h3]Closing thoughts[/h3]
It's been a year since we released the store and demo.
We've come a long way in that time, thanks to your support and feedback.

We'll continue to do our best to make it fun and exciting.
Stay tuned for more from Yonah, the witch with the baseball bat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44923380/fdfb11cb5c7f65e30eb86eb00f80cc290a7132f7.png[/img]
 
Thanks as always :)

2025.03.14
SnakeEagle

hello !
We're SnakeEagle who making games.

We're always listening to everyone who plays and gives us feedback. 
Our goal with this patch was to take that valuable feedback and evolve the game from a "nasty game full of malice" to a "fun game that's worth the challenge".

So we've made the differences between difficulty levels a little clearer,
We've improved the game so that you can overcome RNG with your own skill.
Of course, we've also made improvements to bugs, translation errors, and more.

Below is a breakdown of the changes.

[b]Stage[/b]
- Adjusting the damage range of all monsters
- Adjusted the player hit range for all monsters
- Changed monster "bombs" to be able to be knocked back by attacking them.
- Added tutorials for transformations and effects
- Made some stage level design changes

[b]Boss Battles[/b]
- Improved visibility of spike pattern on the floor of the Stage 1 boss
- Changed the restraint on the Stage 1 boss to be able to be attacked and knocked back.
- Stage 1 boss restraint now move more fluidly.

- Improved the damage effect of hitting Stage 1 boss support monsters to work correctly
- Adjusted Stage 1 boss support monster damage range
- Adjusted player hit range for Stage 1 boss support monsters

- Improved "Hearts" and "Willpower" to fall onto platforms during the platform phase of the Stage 1 boss
- Changed the restraint on the platform stage of the Stage 1 boss to be flying.

[b]Other[/b]
- Full adjustment of advantage/penalty based on difficulty.
- Some improvements to the English translation.
- Changed the player character's English name from "Jonah" to "Yonah".
- Adjusted the player character's jump attack range.
- Changed the borders of character illustrations from white to character-specific colors.

[b]Bugs[/b]
- Fixed a low chance bug that could cause the floor to pierce when moving around the map.
- Fixed a bug where a player's jump attack would not finish if they touched the floor during the attack.
- Fixed a bug where players would be able to move while still in mid-air if they hit the ground during an jump attack.
- Fixed a bug where pressing the Submit key repeatedly during game over would cause the scene to skip forward
- Fixed a bug where post-processing would not be applied correctly in the final phase of the Stage 1 boss

*If the update was successful, you should see v0.4 in the bottom right corner of the main screen.
If you don't see it, please uninstall and reinstall the game.

Feedback is always welcome!
Please stay tuned on [KILL THE WITCH]!
